scope: Acquisition, file provenance, licensing and observed map bindings for the private 008 material trials. This is not a material, prototype, renderer, package or publication approval.

rights.limitations: CC0 verification concerns the identified ambientCG files. It does not certify the independent identity, shape quality or reference fidelity of the authored geometry, scene, materials or sampled point data. Version-specific visual decisions remain in their actual review receipts.

stageReferences.v2VisualDecision: Separate actual evidence review required; no approval is asserted by this provenance record.

verification.fileMethod: SHA-256 and byte counts read from actual local files. All eight JPG hashes and byte counts also match their named entries in the retained upstream ZIPs. JPG dimensions decoded from the files; retained WebP dimensions independently decoded with Pillow.
verification.cropAndVisualReview: Texture maps repeat on 3D surfaces rather than use photograph crops. Desktop/mobile framing, lighting, material appearance and four-state adequacy are not approved here.

textureLicense.name: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
textureLicense.distributionBasis: ambientCG explicitly covers downloadable assets and their material preview renders with CC0, including commercial redistribution and raw files inside a project. Attribution is optional. This supports including the identified maps in an editable template source package after its separate production and package gates pass.
textureLicense.processing: The eight selected 1K JPG maps were extracted without re-encoding or pixel editing; their hashes match the archive entries. Shader color, normal strength, repeat and displacement settings do not modify those source files.
